name: yardimci-asistan
description: Küçük işletmeler için local-first Yardımcı Asistan monorepo iskeleti.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/android-app
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/shared && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/whatsapp-bridge && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/ai-core && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/sync-core && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/web-widget
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/smoke-database-schema.mjs && npm run e2e && node scripts/smoke-desktop-appearance.mjs
scripts.check:linux: npm run doctor && npm run lint:php && npm run smoke:local-lab && npm run smoke:web-form-api && npm run smoke:web-module && npm run smoke:android-device-approval-hosting && npm run smoke:android-device-token && npm run smoke:android-release-connection && npm run check && npm run pack:web-module:no-build && npm run smoke:web-widget-branding:no-build && npm run smoke:web-widget-module:no-build && npm run smoke:automatic-sync:no-build && npm run smoke:android-hosting:no-build && npm run smoke:room-folio-transfer:no-build && npm run smoke:desktop-renderer && npm run smoke:desktop-lock && npm run smoke:desktop-package:no-build && npm run smoke:desktop:linux:no-build
scripts.quality:core: npm run architecture:audit && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.quality:strict: npm run lint:strict && npm run knip:strict && npm run design:audit:strict && npm run quality:core
scripts.smoke:desktop-renderer: node scripts/smoke-desktop-renderer.mjs && node scripts/smoke-desktop-design-system.mjs && node scripts/smoke-desktop-shell.mjs && node scripts/smoke-desktop-customer-pension.mjs && node scripts/smoke-finance-workspace.mjs && node scripts/smoke-messages-ai-staleness.mjs && node scripts/smoke-messages-takeover-lifecycle.mjs && node scripts/smoke-dashboard-workspace.mjs && node scripts/smoke-calendar-workspace.mjs
scripts.smoke:room-folio-transfer: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && node scripts/smoke-room-folio-table-order-transfer.mjs
scripts.smoke:ai-contract: npm test -w @yardimci-asistan/shared && npm test -w @yardimci-asistan/ai-core && node scripts/smoke-web-module-menu.mjs && node scripts/smoke-desktop-design-system.mjs
scripts.smoke:automatic-sync: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/sync-core && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && node scripts/smoke-automatic-sync.mjs
scripts.smoke:desktop:linux: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/sync-core && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && node scripts/smoke-desktop-clean-startup.mjs && node scripts/smoke-app-lock.mjs && node scripts/smoke-android-permission-matrix.mjs && node scripts/smoke-table-categories-db.mjs && node scripts/smoke-record-deletions.mjs && node scripts/smoke-customer-room-management-db.mjs && node scripts/smoke-stock-image-import-db.mjs && node scripts/smoke-reports-db.mjs && node scripts/smoke-finance-db.mjs && node scripts/smoke-finance-service.mjs && node scripts/smoke-room-folio-service.mjs && node scripts/smoke-room-folio-table-order-transfer.mjs && node scripts/smoke-desktop-xvfb.mjs
scripts.smoke:desktop:linux:no-build: node scripts/smoke-desktop-clean-startup.mjs && node scripts/smoke-app-lock.mjs && node scripts/smoke-android-permission-matrix.mjs && node scripts/smoke-table-categories-db.mjs && node scripts/smoke-record-deletions.mjs && node scripts/smoke-customer-room-management-db.mjs && node scripts/smoke-stock-image-import-db.mjs && node scripts/smoke-reports-db.mjs && node scripts/smoke-finance-db.mjs && node scripts/smoke-finance-service.mjs && node scripts/smoke-room-folio-service.mjs && node scripts/smoke-room-folio-table-order-transfer.mjs && node scripts/smoke-desktop-xvfb.mjs
scripts.pack:desktop:dir: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && npm run pack:dir -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app
scripts.pack:desktop:win: npm run android:release-apk && node scripts/prepare-desktop-android-resources.mjs --platform win32 && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && npm run pack:win -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app
scripts.pack:desktop:win32: npm run android:release-apk && node scripts/prepare-desktop-android-resources.mjs --platform win32 && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && npm run pack:win32 -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app
scripts.pack:desktop:windows: npm run android:release-apk && node scripts/prepare-desktop-android-resources.mjs --platform win32 && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && npm run pack:win -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && npm run pack:win32 -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app
scripts.pack:desktop:linux: npm run android:release-apk && node scripts/prepare-desktop-android-resources.mjs --platform linux && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && npm run pack:linux -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app
scripts.smoke:local-companion: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/sync-core && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && node scripts/smoke-local-companion-server.mjs
scripts.smoke:hospitality-domain: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/shared && tsc -p apps/desktop-app/tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/smoke-hospitality-domain.mjs
scripts.smoke:table-order-domain: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/shared && tsc -p apps/desktop-app/tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/smoke-desktop-menu-db.mjs --table-orders-only
scripts.smoke:operations-projections: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/shared && tsc -p apps/desktop-app/tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/smoke-operations-projections.mjs
scripts.smoke:pre-main:extras: npm run smoke:settings-platform && npm run smoke:business-layout && npm run smoke:hospitality-domain && npm run smoke:pension-workspace && npm run smoke:restaurant-workspace && npm run smoke:operations-ui && npm run smoke:operations-projections && npm run smoke:table-customer && npm run smoke:diagnostics && npm run smoke:workspace-platform && node scripts/smoke-android-reservation-actions.mjs && node scripts/smoke-android-daily-task-actions.mjs && node scripts/smoke-android-finance-actions.mjs && node scripts/smoke-android-room-folio-actions.mjs
scripts.pre-main: npm run check:linux && npm run lint:strict && npm run knip:strict && npm run design:audit:strict && npm run architecture:audit && npm run pilot:check:full && npm run smoke:pre-main:extras && git diff --check
